title: Price-aware laboratory panels for mortality risk: code, models and calculator
description: Code, fitted model coefficients, the value-of-information ordering chart and an offline web calculator accompanying the article "Price-aware laboratory panels for mortality risk: development and external validation in five population cohorts from three countries". No participant data are included; the survey data are available from their providers.
